title: Shy Wolf Sanctuary
specs: Home to nearly 40 exotic residents including wolves, wolfdogs, foxes, coyotes, and gopher tortoises
Located on 2.5 acres with shaded walkways and benches
Educational focus on rescue, sanctuary, and animal lessons
Children must be at least 7 years old
One adult per three children under 10 years old
All guests under 18 must be accompanied by an adult
Guests must follow all rules and directions from volunteer guides
Special events for up to 20 guests

options.name: Special Event Package
options.detail: Tour and light brunch for up to 20 guests

variants.label: Tour and light brunch for up to 20 guests

includes: Guided visit and talk by trained guides
Opportunity to photograph animals for personal use
gap: Exact donation amount for group visits not stated
blurb: Guests join a 90-minute guided walk through the sanctuary to learn about and experience rescued animals up close. The sanctuary houses nearly 40 exotic residents on 2.5 acres with winding foliage-covered paths. Visits are by reservation only and include educational talks and photo opportunities.
extraNote: Reservations required; no walk-ins accepted · Donation per person collected upon scheduling, non-refundable · Closed Tuesdays, Thursdays, and major holidays · Visit operates rain or shine; lightning causes delay or reschedule · Guests should arrive 15 minutes prior to scheduled time · Back patio of the sanctuary for initial introduction
